free_tier.stated: no standing free tier: a new account can earn up to EUR 15 in credit when signing up, and running time is capped by a package monthly price
free_tier.notes: The EUR 15 sign-up credit is stated on the documentation index; the amount a given account earns is not stated there.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a microVM with a workspace disk, not an object; the GP-G2-4GB package carries 32 GB of workspace
per_object_cap.notes: The workspace sizes are stated per package, for example 32 GB on GP-G2-4GB.

retention.stated: a sandbox lives until the user deletes it; after 5 idle minutes it sleeps and only its workspace disk is billed; max_lifetime_sec sets automatic cleanup

egress.terms: not published for sandboxes on the page read: outbound internet over NAT in isolated mode, no access to the project private network unless overlay mode is opted in

interface_detail: REST API at https://api.nodion.com, a hosted MCP server and a web terminal; the CLI page states sandboxes are not in the CLI yet
tooling: a personal API key (nodion_…) scoped to sandbox read, write or exec; REST, MCP and a dashboard web terminal; sandboxes are not in the CLI yet
chaining: a hosted microVM for running untrusted agent code, with HTTPS previews and access to the same project's databases in overlay mode

limits.value: EUR 20,00 per month of running time at most on the GP-G2-4GB package (EUR 0,0278 per hour)
after 5 idle minutes the sandbox sleeps and only its workspace disk is billed; max_lifetime_sec sets automatic cleanup
a command over the API runs up to 15 minutes per call

limits_note: Personal API keys can be limited to sandbox read, write or exec. Billing starts once the sandbox runs, and deleting it stops billing.
binding_note: The package's EUR 20,00 monthly ceiling on running time is the first hard cap; a sandbox that runs for the whole month cannot exceed it.

identity_cost.detail: the hosted sign-in page presents 'Log in or sign up' with a Google or GitHub provider button or an email and password; no phone number, ID document or card is shown at sign-in, and a card is not stated for the sign-up credit

reliability_note: the sandbox sleeps after 5 idle minutes and is deleted only when the user deletes it or max_lifetime_sec elapses; no further reliability event is stated on the pages read
confidence_note: the sandbox page, the documentation index and the API page were read on 2026-11-25; the sign-in gate was read from the hosted app's own JavaScript bundle, and the pricing from the vendor's sandbox page

evidence.proved: API calls are rate limited per account and a 429 carries Retry-After
evidence.quote: Key-authenticated calls are rate limited per account. Responses include `RateLimit-Limit`, `RateLimit-Remaining`, and `RateLimit-Reset`. A `429` also sends `Retry-After`. Every response has `X-Request-Id`.
